environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding traffic directly to the container on port 8080. The task role has s3:GetObject on the config bucket. The ALB security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No rate limiting, no WAF attached. The container responds with distinguishable HTTP status codes (403 vs 500) for padding errors vs other decryption errors, enabling a classic padding oracle attack.

config.network: public subnet, ALB with internet-facing listener
